updates: Answers can show pictures the agent generated or found on the web, and each one opens in a viewer
Image generation can use a cloud model from a connected provider, picked in Settings next to the local models
Voice chat can speak with a cloud voice model and pick its voice
Statistics price each local turn at the OpenRouter rate of the model it is based on, and break the cost down by model
The image step in a chat folds into a dropdown once the picture is done
A message you sent to steer a running answer can be taken back and edited
Research marks a quote it could not find on the page and lists the sources of each run
fixes: A cloud model chosen as the default now opens with the app
A llama.cpp server left over from an earlier run no longer keeps an old context window
Web search during research waits for a provider to cool down instead of failing with no request
The browser pane opens when the agent visits a page
Voice chat no longer stops at "Loading voice model"

updates: The Windows app now runs on Tauri instead of Electron. Your settings, chats and saved keys carry over, and the old install is removed after the upgrade
Agent commands on Windows run in a sandbox that only sees the project folder and the toolchains on your PATH
npm, npx, vitest and other Node tools ask once and then run outside the sandbox, where they work
Always allow now covers a command prefix, so allowing `npm run` covers every script
The browser pane blocks more ads, including scriptlet filters, and its popped-out window has a bar of its own
Window controls are drawn in the app's title bar
fixes: Node commands no longer hang in the sandbox and get retried for dozens of steps
The administrator prompt for the sandbox appears once per machine, not at every launch
Sandboxed commands can list the folders above the project, so PowerShell and `dir` work there

updates: Draggy updates itself on Windows, macOS and Linux at startup
Every tool call shows live in the chat
Read only tool calls run in parallel
New deep research, fact check
Assistant turns are redesigned and way better
Russian replaces Chinese as an interface language
AMD graphics cards use the ROCm build of llama.cpp automatically
fixes: Removed the broken Gemini account provider
